LanguageData.USAC_NeuroBooster.label: neuro-booster
LanguageData.USAC_NeuroBooster.description: A potent neuro-augment serum that enhances neural activity and rational thinking. Widely used by USAC technical workers and soldiers. It is highly addictive and must be taken regularly to keep the user stable, but it delivers a substantial boost to bandwidth and awareness.\n\nA small number of susceptible individuals have died of unexplained anaphylactic shock while nanomachine activity was low. USAC maintains that it holds substantial evidence of the product's harmlessness.
